cohort_role: workflow-untouched structural cases; model-family-unseen status not certified
execution_scope: Prospective full-parent pose docking with matched one-site budgets for modern Vina and original Vina-Carb across strict/repair receptor profiles; no repaired site prediction
failure_policy: All6cases and all18methodconditions in each receptor profile retained; strict4unsupported/incomplete cases stayfailed where source chemical prep cannot pass; repairMSEunsupported retained. No source, candidate, score mask or case replacement based on performance

ligand.export: Meeko PDBQT with frozen canonical Lxxx names restored; exact full graph/charges/fresh3Dstereo/rounded CCDgeometry validated
ligand.generation: source-only ETKDG with pinned CCD ideal intraring bounds/dihedrals and predeclared constrained optimization/selection; no native 3D; literal selected SDF copied without extra embedding/minimization during export

source_only_policy.chemical_inputs: Full parent heavy graph from pinned CCD atom/bond/formal-charge/stereo definitions and declared chemical branch links. Only pdbx_model_Cartn_{x,y,z}_ideal fields may supply monomer chemical geometry. No experimental/native ligand coordinates, ligand pose, receptor or docking box is read.

constraints.embedding: Ordinary independent ETKDGv3 without customdistancebounds or coordMap. Only subsequent within-ring MMFF pair distances and absolute signedtorsions use CCD chemicalideal geometry.

source_only_policy.coordinates_after_selection: Retain the constrained optimized conformer. No subsequent unconstrained MMFF relaxation is part of this profile. Glycosidic orientations remain independently sampled and are never fitted to native geometry.
source_only_policy.development_amendment: Both v1 and v2 complete20-slot failures/source snapshots preserved. Tight customDG bounds caused initial-coordinate/finalchiral-bounds rejection beforeMMFF. Version3 uses ordinaryETKDG followed by sameintraringMMFFconstraints, notnative fitting; fixes internalDGsolvertrialceiling at1000 per20candidate slots and strengthens graph/nondegeneracyevidence. No docking/accuracyoutcomes were used.
source_only_policy.interpretation: A constrained independent chemical-ideal chair initialization sensitivity. It is not a free-energy ensemble, a claim all bound sugars adopt the CCD chair, or permission to change a frozen primary preparation or run a new docking study before a separate root freeze.

sampling.budget_definition: Exactly20candidate conformer slots. Each ETKDG solver call has a fixed1000 internal embedding-trial ceiling; this is not an adaptive candidate-pool enlargement. Allslot failures retained.

source_only_policy.selection: Evaluate every fixed candidate slot. Among converged candidates passing all gates, choose the smallest unconstrained MMFF94 energy evaluated at the constrained geometry; tie by slot index. Never select by experimental/native similarity, docking, or a desired outcome. Record every failed slot and reason; fail if no valid candidate.
source_only_policy.source_math: aav_benchmark/ring_geometry.py: original Cremer-Pople equations, fixed named cyclic order. Full named pucker-vector comparison is required; nearest-chair-pole distance alone cannot distinguish opposite chairs.
source_only_policy.stereo_assignment: Assign each independent CCD monomer's tetrahedral tags from its chemical-ideal geometry, transfer to full connected graph with explicit leaving-atom substitution and neighbor permutation parity. Discard all monomer conformers before independent embedding. Named signed volumes and full-parent isomeric graph must survive.
source_only_policy.supported_ring_scope: Exactly one complete six-membered pyranose ring per component; other ring sizes or ambiguous ring identity fail explicitly. No extension to septanoses or unusual enzyme-bound puckers is inferred.

ligand_policy: One fixed source-only independently generated CCD-ideal full-parent conformer per case; no native 3D coordinates, no extra re-embedding/minimization during Meeko export; full chemical graph/formalcharge/stereo and canonical Lxxx key bijection preserved
paired_design: Identical original full-assembly V2 predictor candidate centers/ranks, independent CCD-ideal ligand bytes, box dimensions and Vina settings across strict/repair; only declared protein preparation differs

pose_endpoints.reference_mask: same canonical scored atom mask for every qualified same-chemical assembly copy; separate full_ligand and modeled_core strata

pose_gate: Do not compute atomic or site accuracy until all planned strict+repair execution records are terminal; failed chemistry/predictor/preparation/execution remains workflow failure

prediction.orbit_deduplication: only rigid declared assembly operators certified by bijective whole-protein atom correspondence; otherwise no_orbit_dedupe
prediction.scope: whole source biological-assembly dry protein; all deposited protein modifications retained; all waters, glycans and metals removed uniformly

preparation_sensitivity_planned_before_t.secondary: separately frozen deterministic missing-standard-sidechain repair, observedatomsfixed, no missingloop insertion orMSEconversion; sameoriginalblindcandidateboxes; generatedcoordinatesnotexperimentaltruth
